# Language Atlas

> > Language Atlas provides structured French and Spanish learning resources with CEFR-aligned grammar lessons, verb conjugations, Anki flashcard decks with IPA pronunciation, and cultural content.

Created by Sam Denishin and Dan Forsythe, Language Atlas offers comprehensive curriculum organized by CEFR levels (A1, A2, B1, B2) with interactive quizzes, spaced repetition tools, and detailed grammar explanations for French and Spanish learners.

## Key Topics

- French grammar and verb conjugation
- Spanish vocabulary and grammar
- CEFR levels (A1, A2, B1, B2)
- Anki flashcard decks
- International Phonetic Alphabet (IPA)
- Spaced repetition learning
- Passé composé and futur simple tenses
- French definite articles and pronouns
- Spanish prepositions
- Language learning methodology
- Pronunciation practice
- Interactive grammar quizzes
- Reflexive verbs
- Interrogative forms
- Vocabulary memorization

## Anki Vocabulary Decks

- [Spanish A2 Vocabulary Anki](https://languageatlas.com/anki/spanish-a2-vocabulary-anki): Spanish A2 Vocabulary Anki Deck with IPA pronunciation for flashcards
- [Spanish B2 Vocabulary Anki](https://languageatlas.com/anki/spanish-b2-vocabulary-anki): Spanish B2 Vocabulary Anki Deck with IPA pronunciation for flashcards

## French A1 Fundamentals

- [How To Say The In French = Le, La, And L'](https://languageatlas.com/french-a1/how-to-say-the-in-french): French A1 definite articles: le, la, l' with gender and noun rules
- [Tu Or Vous? [How To Use Them +9 Examples]](https://languageatlas.com/french-a1/tu-or-vous): French A1 guide to formal/informal pronouns tu vs vous with examples
- [Se Coucher Conjugation In The Present Tense [+7 Examples & Quiz]](https://languageatlas.com/french-a1/se-coucher-conjugation-in-the-present-tense): French A1 reflexive verb se coucher present tense conjugation guide
- [How To Make Adjectives Plural In French = (add -s/-es)](https://languageatlas.com/french-a1/how-to-make-adjectives-plural-in-french): French A1 plural adjectives: agreement rules and -s/-es endings

## French A2 Grammar & Conjugation

- [Regular Re Verbs Conjugation In The Passé Composé](https://languageatlas.com/french-a2/regular-re-verbs-conjugation-in-the-passe-compose): French A2 regular -re verbs passé composé conjugation lesson
- [Connaître Conjugation In The Passé Composé](https://languageatlas.com/french-a2/connaitre-conjugation-in-the-passe-compose): French A2 connaître irregular verb passé composé conjugation guide
- [How To Form Inverted Questions With Nouns [+6 Examples & Quiz]](https://languageatlas.com/french-a2/inverted-questions-with-nouns): French A2 grammar: forming inverted questions with nouns and examples
- [How To Form Whom Questions In French [+6 Examples & Quiz]](https://languageatlas.com/french-a2/whom-questions-in-french): French A2 interrogatives: forming whom questions with qui usage

## French B1 Advanced Conjugation

- [Regular Ir Verbs Futur Simple Conjugation [+6 Examples & Quiz]](https://languageatlas.com/french-b1/regular-ir-verbs-futur-simple): French B1 lesson on regular -ir verbs futur simple conjugation with quiz
- [Devoir Conditionnel Présent Conjugation [+6 Examples & Quiz]](https://languageatlas.com/french-b1/devoir-conditionnel-present): French B1 devoir verb conditionnel présent conjugation with quiz
- [Croire Futur Simple Conjugation [+6 Examples & Quiz]](https://languageatlas.com/french-b1/croire-futur-simple): French B1 croire verb futur simple conjugation with examples and quiz

## Spanish Grammar Lessons

- [From Until/From To In Spanish [+10 Examples & Quiz]](https://languageatlas.com/spanish-a2/from-until-from-to-in-spanish): Spanish A2 prepositions lesson: desde-hasta and de-a with examples
- [Venir Present Tense Conjugation [+6 Examples & Quiz]](https://languageatlas.com/spanish-a1/venir-present-tense): Spanish A1 venir present tense conjugation with examples and quiz

## Cultural & Travel Guides

- [8 Top Universities In Spain For International Students](https://languageatlas.com/blog/universities-in-spain): Guide to top universities in Spain for international students
- [10 Exhilarating Festivals In Spain Unlike Any Other](https://languageatlas.com/blog/festivals-in-spain): Guide to unique Spanish festivals including La Batalla del Vino in Haro
- [6 Most Interesting French Slang Words And Phrases](https://languageatlas.com/blog/french-slang-words-and-phrases): Colloquial French slang words and phrases for conversational learning
- [10 Of The Most Beautiful Villages Of France](https://languageatlas.com/blog/beautiful-villages-of-france): Travel guide to Les Plus Beaux Villages de France including Sancerre
